Hasselblad

When I got my hands on a Hasselblad, I did not want to use it for just one thing. I wanted to see how it would answer to different subjects. This body of work covers portraits, street scenes, landscapes, and some more personal, more private views. Each subject taught me the camera's language again: its detail, its dynamic range, how it renders light and shadow, and how it changes the way I see.

Works marked DEEP ZOOM can be opened and explored at full resolution.
